## Description
Briefly explain the goal and motivation behind these changes.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactoring / performance improvement
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔒 Security / Cryptography update
- [ ] 📦 Packaging / CI/CD update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and analysis rules of this project (`flutter analyze` has 0 issues).
- [ ] I have added or updated tests to cover my changes (`flutter test` passes 100%).
- [ ] I have updated the relevant documentation (e.g. `README.md`, `docs/format-v1.md`) if applicable.
- [ ] No sensitive credentials, private keys, or test vaults are committed.
